notes:
Video Studio now defaults to 9:16 Phone (Reels). Enter a duration and style in a single prompt. Music videos can generate their own local lyrics, song, performance shots, and cutaways, then save a scored MP4 in Recent clips. The preceding stable version could render a rap video silently.

Brick-movie prompts now call for expressive molded minifigures, printed outfits, foreground performances, and detailed sets. The earlier development preview tended to generate cluttered tabletop displays. The update covers ordinary scene prompts as well as music videos. The local models generate the artwork anew. The film does not require reference photos or a manually edited soundtrack.

Phone frames use overlapping decode tiles. Brick performances can draw a full five-second shot in one batch. Regression tests covered normal scene isolation, prompt duration, default frame, reference reuse, motion cadence, and soundtrack muxing.

Source commit ccae70b0ba2ba16a04e220c654a13297916e0977.
A single plain-language rap-video prompt produced a 60-second phone MP4 on the test PC in 36 minutes 37 seconds, including song generation. The export contains 1,440 frames, 12 shots using four generated visual references, and stereo audio. Native playback and Recent clips were verified.
